name: Driplet
summary:
Driplet is the easiest way to get your recordings off your headset.

Capture a clip, open Driplet, pick your videos and tap your PC. They land on your computer in full quality within seconds, and nothing is ever uploaded to the cloud.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Send videos and screenshots from your headset to your PC with one tap
• Send files, links and text from your PC back to your headset
• Pair once with a 6 digit code so your devices find each other automatically
• Choose what to accept, or let your paired dev
